$comment: REPLACE_WITH_ABSOLUTE_REPO_PATH must become the absolute path to this repository. Claude
Desktop launches the server with no working directory of its own, so a relative path has
THE COMMAND IS `uv run --directory`, NOT `uvx taxcalc-mcp-server`. This server depends on
taxcalc-ai, a sibling project published to no registry: the built wheel carries a bare
`Requires-Dist: taxcalc-ai`, so uvx and pipx both fail to resolve it. `uv run --directory`
runs the project in place, where [tool.uv.sources] applies. Verified from an unrelated
working directory, and guarded by the 'documented launch command' step in CI.
THE ENV VALUES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS AND MUST STAY THAT WAY IN GIT. Claude Desktop reads
this file literally - it does not expand $VARS and it does not read a keychain - so the
only way a real token reaches the process is for something to write it into this file on
disk. A launcher script should rewrite it from the OS keychain (macOS Keychain, Windows
DPAPI) at each Claude Desktop start. Never commit a real token here.
TAXCALC_MCP_BEARER_JWT is the credential forwarded to taxcalc-orders and llm-proxy.
TAXCALC_MCP_ORDERS_SVC_URL and TAXCALC_MCP_LLM_PROXY_URL select which services to reach.
LANGSMITH_API_KEY is required: taxcalc_ai.rag raises at import without it, so the RAG tool
is the one that fails without it - the other three work regardless.
